677:t_017:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's 'Lion' by the $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$!」

677:t_017:3.en:
$$シェリル$$
($$アルト$$... I'll deliver my feelings to you...)

677:t_017:4.en:
$$シェリル$$
(No, not only to you. To everyone, to the $$バジュラ$$, to the galaxy...)

677:t_017:7.en:
$$アルト$$
($$シェリル$$... Your feelings are reaching me...)

677:t_017:8.en:
$$アルト$$
(I knew it, it was you... You were the girl I met back then...)

677:t_018:2.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Impossible! These readings are beyond anything we projected!」

677:t_019:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ are falling back!」

677:t_019:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Those guys! They broke free of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s control!」

677:t_019:2.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Damn it! Amplify the fold wave from the queen!」

677:t_019:3.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「The adjustment will take a little time!」

677:t_019:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll take you down before that!」

677:t_019:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Let's do this, you lugs! Our target is $$バトル・フロンティア$$, fused with the queen!」

677:t_019:8.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'm going! With these wings, I'll deliver your songs to the $$バジュラ$$!)

677:t_020:0.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「The adjustment of the fold wave amplification system is complete.」

677:t_020:1.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Good...! Recall the $$バジュラ$$ units!」

677:t_021:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ランカ$$ and the others' song isn't working!?」

677:t_021:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It's no good! The fold wave coming from $$バトル・フロンティア$$ is being amplified!」

677:t_021:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Then we'll answer with a chorus!」

677:t_021:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「A song is never some special power! All you have to do is let out the feelings everyone carries, honestly!」

677:t_021:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Got it! We'll unite our feelings too!」

677:t_021:7.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「$$ランカ$$! You take the lead!」

677:t_022:1.en:
$$レド$$
(But it doesn't feel bad... So this is... a song...)

677:t_022:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Come to think of it... we all sang together like this during the $$破界事変$$ too...)

677:t_022:4.en:
$$タケル$$
(That was right after the battle in Antarctica...)

677:t_022:5.en:
$$桂$$
(Our song back then crossed space-time and worked a miracle, didn't it...)

677:t_022:6.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「This is strange! A faint fold wave is being detected from every one of them!」

677:t_022:7.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「What's going on! Have they all come down with V-type infection!?」

677:t_022:10.en:
$$不動$$
「I'm hardly someone worth naming. But I will tell you this much.」

677:t_022:11.en:
$$不動$$
「A song is not a mere vibration of the air. That which shakes every soul, across time and across place, is what is called a true song...」

677:t_022:12.en:
$$不動$$
「Now that they are grasping the truth, they can shake space-time with the power of life.」

677:t_022:13.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Defold reaction! Something is coming!」

677:t_023:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$バジュラ$$ that aren't under anyone's control!?」

677:t_023:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can tell! That's the $$バジュラ$$ swarm from the $$再世戦争$$!」

677:t_024:0.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Why!? Why won't they obey the orders of the amplified fold wave!?」

677:t_024:4.en:
$$不動$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ you tried to control came to this world, in truth, to meet those $$バジュラ$$ over there.」

677:t_024:5.en:
$$不動$$
「To cross space-time and weave love, that is.」

677:t_024:6.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Their song... broke through the dimensional wall and called their breeding partners, the $$バジュラ$$...」

677:t_024:7.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「So they're following their instinct to pass on their species, and ignoring our orders!?」

677:t_024:8.en:
$$不動$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ of this planet must have been bewildered too... They came to meet another swarm, only to find it living among unknown creatures.」

677:t_024:9.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「You mean $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$!」

677:t_024:10.en:
$$不動$$
「It's the same as in the $$再世戦争$$. ...They attacked humans to save the ones they loved. Thinking those girls' songs were calls for help too.」

677:t_024:11.en:
$$不動$$
「But in the end, those girls' feelings reached the $$バジュラ$$, and what's more, the two swarms came to meet in this world.」

677:t_024:13.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Thank you, $$アイ君$$... You helped carry our feelings to the swarm too, didn't you.)

677:t_024:14.en:
$$ランカ$$
($$アルト$$ and the others will surely save your queen. So you can rest easy.)

677:t_025:0.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Take care, $$アイ君$$. I hope we meet again someday...)

677:t_025:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! Incoming transmission from the $$マクロス７船団$$!」

677:t_025:2.en:
$$ボビー$$
「So they've made contact with them!」

677:t_025:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now's our chance! Let's hit $$バトル・フロンティア$$!」

677:t_026:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Boys! There's a good wave coming in!」

677:t_027:0.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Damn it! Like this, the amplification system can't be used anymore!」

677:t_027:1.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「You mean we can't call any more $$バジュラ$$ swarms!?」

677:t_027:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Incoming from Captain $$マクシミリアン$$ of the $$マクロス７船団$$! From now on, he's entrusting command of every fleet's $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in this world to Captain $$ジェフリー$$!」

677:t_027:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$マクロス・クォーター$$ fleet, huh... Comrades worth having.」

677:t_027:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Also, the regular forces of each fleet are reportedly assembling at the galactic center!」
